about_the_game:
Overcome your past and become someone new. A game about love, loss and being lost in life.

In Truer than You, you play as 26-year old non-binary Rin who’s recently moved to a big city to start their new life and a new position at the secretive company Truer than You, specializing in renting out actors for real life situations.

Now, it’s up to you to do your gigs without breaking the company rules or becoming exposed. You'll navigate situations by making choices and having conversations to get a good rating. Maybe you'll even become employee of the month!?

But playing someone else isn’t always easy. Sometimes you’ll end up in situations where the borders start to blur. You might even meet someone that you start caring a little extra for… Then, what do you do?

And, as Rin gets on with their new endeavours, their past is catching up with them. Why did they leave thir old life behind, to start a new life as someone else? In time, they’ll have to deal with who they are and will become.

💎 Explore relationships and dilemmas connected to authenticity and roles in society

💎 Form deeper relationships with three different characters and reveal their back stories
💎 Queer-friendly cast of characters and relationship types

💎 Choose from more than 1,100 options leading to multiple endings

💎 Flowing conversation mechanic - decide when to speak (or not)

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mentions of and references to sex, non-explicit sexual content in written form, veiled nudity (above chest), instances of alcohol and substance use, and mature language. The game contains themes that might be triggering, such as mentions of suspected suicide.
